pictures.name: QL1-Corinth-Port
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. The busy Greek port city of Corinth in the first century, seen from above at late afternoon: ships with square sails in the harbor, white stone colonnades and a crowded marketplace, a steep rocky mountain with a temple on top behind the city. Merchants, sailors, workers and well-dressed citizens. Warm gold light, deep blue shadows in the streets. Busy and alive.

pictures.name: QL2-Quarrel
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Inside a lamplit room of a Corinthian house in the evening, a small gathering of early Christians, rich and poor, split into two groups facing each other: a well-dressed man in a fine dyed cloak points angrily, a worker in a rough tunic turns away, a woman holds up her hands to calm them. A loaf of bread and a cup sit untouched on the table between them. Tension, division.

pictures.name: QL3-Paul-Writes
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Night in a simple rented room in Ephesus. Paul, a wiry man in his fifties with a short dark-grey beard, balding, in a travel-worn brown wool tunic and cloak, sits at a wooden table by one oil lamp, dictating with an open hand, eyes sad but tender, while a young scribe beside him writes on a papyrus sheet with a reed pen. Rolled letters and a leather bag on a shelf. Quiet, heartfelt.

pictures.name: QL4-Letter-Read
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. The same lamplit room in Corinth, evening. The whole small church sits together on benches and the floor as an older woman in a deep green head covering reads aloud from a papyrus letter held in both hands. The well-dressed man and the worker from before sit nearer now, listening, faces softening. Warm gold light gathering everyone in.

pictures.name: QL5-Love-Acts
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Same Corinthian house, later that night: the well-dressed man in the fine dyed cloak kneels to hand a large piece of bread and a cup to the worker in the rough tunic, who smiles in surprise; around them people share food, an elder pours water for a child. Lamplight on hands and faces. Love as action, reconciliation.

pictures.name: QL6-Today
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern setting painted in the same contemplative oil style, warm light, no readable text, no logos. A modern apartment kitchen in the evening. A young man in a hoodie quietly washes a sink full of dishes left by his roommate, a sticky note-free counter, the roommate asleep on the couch in the next room under a blanket. Soft lamplight. Patient, quiet kindness.
